scientific.integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the local \(S_5\)-quotient coordinates and both curve ideals from the published Sylvester multiplicity patterns. Exact symbolic elimination is bundled and literature-derived premises are separated from new deductions.
limitations: The result is local at the Clebsch point; no local claim is made at the Fermat point, where the moduli parametrization has exceptional behavior.
The calculation determines the two curve germs and their mutual intersection, not the complete local ring of the two-dimensional reducible singular-locus surface.
Classical coincident-root theory is broad; an equivalent local quotient calculation may exist under different invariant coordinates, although none was found in the inspected sources.

title: Cuspidal contact of the two Eckardt singular-locus curves at the Clebsch cubic
